column1: # Rows db.ber.ps.* (line RG, D3c-3a): psiblast -in_pssm of hand-made BER inputs against tests/db_search/paja (-comp_based_stats 0 -evalue 1000, outfmt 7): the reader's length forms (definite lengths, long forms 81 to 89, 80 on a primitive), tags (long forms, an unknown member, members out of order or missing, SET and SEQUENCE swapped), numbers (INTEGER, ENUMERATED, Uint4 and BOOLEAN of other sizes and values), REAL (length 0, the four special values, the decimal forms 00 to 03, long and bad texts, the binary encoding), strings (bytes outside the visible range, the UTF8String tag, StringStore), lengths past the end (of strings, and of byte blocks: block_*, review B1 of D3c-3a, with NCBI's post (803.4) unended byte block when its reserve throws), truncations and bytes after the object. tests/fixtures/pssm/ps9_ber_<case>.asnb (the row id's last word) is made by remaining-gaps-20261112/D/d3/c3a/tools/gen_defects.py from the BER twin of the rnd PSSM (ps9_rnd.asnb): most from ps9_ber_base.asnb, that twin without its intermediateData (the 840 frequency ratios), the row db.ber.ps.base; the cases of a frequency ratio and def_full from the whole twin; store_* from ps9_bad_iupacaa.asnb. psiblast reports any CSerialException of the reader as `Unrecognized format for PSSM in <file> (must be PssmWithParameters)` (blast_args.cpp:1339-1362), so the query cell is the file's own path (pssm:). NCBI 2.17.0 refuses a constructed value with a definite length in the long form (81, 82, ...: def, def_full, def_outer, def_inner, def_list_only, def_but_scores, def_member_long): it takes the data limit from the stream position before reading the other length octets (NCBI reference (598d8ae6): c++/include/serial/impl/objistrasnb.inl:296), so the value ends N octets early and its end check fails (`EndOfContentsByte expected`); short-form definite lengths are read (def_member, def_inst, def_title_variant). Two cases have no row because NCBI ends by a signal (Seq-inst.length 02 01 ff, read as 255 for 30 letters: SIGSEGV; 02 05 00 ff ff ff ff: SIGABRT). Freeze them alone with `freeze --program psiblast --only db.ber.ps.`.
